pages.text: Tooltip and combat share one damage model and show stage, payment and tempering bonus. Anvils accept the current Netherite Sword enchantment set.

Repeatedly smelt the sword in furnaces, blast furnaces, placed Immortal Furnaces or the terminal furnace. Each completion adds one tempering point, grants no experience, and returns the sword to input for continuous processing. Each point adds 1% damage.
After each hit, tempering points halve and round down. Spirit Repair spends the matching Power to repair durability. If payment is unavailable, attacks still deal base weapon damage.
